title: Watts's birth in 1907 and the Palmyra Street neighborhood
summary: Born in New Orleans on 17 February 1907, near Palmyra and Roman Streets; asked about music around the house.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: But let's start off at the beginning. Where were you born? New Orleans. Do you mind telling your birth date exactly?
February 17th. Well you didn't have a birth date too long ago.
And exactly where were you born? What part of New Orleans? Or a town. Or a town. Let me see. Or do you know where you grew up anyway?
I think it was on Palmyra Street. Palmyra near Roman. Mm-hmm.
That must have had some music going on around there, some kind or another. Singing a music that you heard when you were young.
